title: LuckRead D1-04 W07 Remote Schema Runner Review and Release

findings: D1-04 remote run 42553336881 committed all six W07 schema migrations and their ledger rows, then failed final index catalog verification because pg_indexes included PostgreSQL constraint-backed indexes in the explicit-index comparison.
limitations: The D1-04 runner/index catalog correction is pending CI validation and a fresh source-pinned review.
No submitted GitHub review records are present; the prior GPT-6 code review is not a human GitHub APPROVE review.
Remote Neon DDL execution history is recorded in executionHistory; run 42553336881 applied the six schema migrations but failed final catalog verification.
Neon database UUID is pinned from existing W07 D1_04 Wrangler metadata; PostgreSQL SQL cannot independently verify the Neon control-plane UUID.

executionHistory.failureReason: The catalog query used pg_catalog.pg_indexes, which includes PostgreSQL indexes backing primary-key and unique constraints. The reviewed manifest contains 31 explicit indexes and a separate exact list of 29 constraint-backed indexes.
executionHistory.recovery: A retry reads and validates the complete ordered six-row ledger prefix, skips the already committed migrations, and reruns final catalog verification. No cleanup or migration replay is needed.
